Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 a_lov boolean;
BEGIN

IF :control_blk.driveid is NULL THEN
 :control_blk.driveid := '';
END IF;
IF :control_blk.driveid is not null THEN
BEGIN 
 select drives.drive_id 
 into :control_blk.driveid
 from drives, drive_sponsors ,sponsors 
 where drive_type in ('I','C') 
 and ( name like '%'||nvl(:control_blk.driveid,'')||'%' 
 or drives.drive_id = :control_blk.driveid )
 and drives.status = 'CNFRM' 
 and drives.drive_date between :control_blk.drive_date and :control_blk.end_date
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and drive_sponsors.drive_id =drives.drive_id 
 and sponsors.sponsor_id = drive_sponsors.sponsor_id 
 and sponsors.chapter_id =drives.chapter_id ;
EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11109');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 a_lov := show_lov('lov_drive_id');
END;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
query_count number:=0;
BEGIN
 if :control_blk.end_date is null then
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure;
 end if ;
 if (trunc(:control_blk.drive_date) > trunc(:control_blk.end_date)) then
 show_error('9192');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_block('drives_blk');
 check_package_Failure ;

 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 select count(*) into query_count from drives
 where drive_date between :control_blk.drive_date and
 :control_blk.end_date and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 drive_id = nvl(:control_blk.driveid,drive_id) and
 rownum=1;
 if (query_count = 1) then
 execute_query;
 else
 message('Query fetched no records');
 go_item('control_blk.drive_date');
end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SPONSOR_INSTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/** fetches sponsor preferences for a sponsor_id **/
PROCEDURE get_sponsor_instr IS
begin
declare
query_count number:= 0;
v_date date;

BEGIN
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 select count(*) into query_count
 from sponsor_preferences 
 where sponsor_id = :drives_blk.sponsor_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1) and
 rownum=1;
 
 set_item_property('sponsor_preferences.preference_code',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 go_block('sponsor_preferences');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 if(query_count=1) then
 execute_query;
 set_item_property('sponsor_preferences.preference_code',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 go_item('control_blk.back');
 /* else
 show_error('12050');
 check_package_failure;*/
 end if; 
 
 END;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select substr(to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),1,8) drive_date,
name , drives.drive_id ,
drives.drive_date drivedate 
from drives, drive_sponsors ,sponsors 
where drive_type in ('I','C') 
and name like '%'||nvl(:control_blk.driveid,'')||'%' 
and drives.status = 'CNFRM' 
and drives.drive_date between :control_blk.drive_date and :control_blk.end_date
and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
and drive_sponsors.drive_id=drives.drive_id 
and sponsors.sponsor_id = drive_sponsors.sponsor_id 
and sponsors.chapter_id=drives.chapter_id 
order by 4
